_help._file: How the board looks and how a round flows. Live in the Dev Kit's Tuning tab: move a slider and the running game changes.
_help.cellSize: How big one square is, in px, at most. The board still shrinks to fit a small window.
_help.boardShare: How much of the window's shorter side the board may take (0-1), so the seats and the HUD keep their room.
_help.resultsDelayMs: After the last move, how long (ms) the finished board stays in view before the results open. On the rules clock: a pause holds it.
_help.winPulseMs: How long one pulse of the winning line takes (ms). On the looks clock: a half pause keeps it pulsing.
